name: openai-images-protocol
notes: Generic profile for ANY endpoint implementing the OpenAI-style Images wire protocol (POST {base}/images/generations JSON, POST {base}/images/edits multipart). This is a protocol, not a vendor: set IMAGE_API_BASE_URL to whichever service you use (e.g. https://<host>/v1) and IMAGE_API_KEY to its key. Add model_map entries if that service names models differently. Verify in the service's docs that it supports quality/complexity values for the chosen model. model_select.py probes GET {base}/models to see which models are actually served; if that endpoint does not exist the profile is treated as 'may serve any model' and the agent must verify.

list_models.note: used by model_select.py plan to verify which models this endpoint really serves
